It makes a combat manoeuvre check (caster level + casting ability modifier + 8) against each creature it strikes; on a success the creature is knocked prone and carried along. A carried creature may try to escape as a standard action (CMB or Swim against the wave's CMB); failing deals another 6d6 bludgeoning (Fortitude half). Huge or smaller objects are swept along; larger or fixed ones take 8d6 ignoring hardness. Freedom of movement prevents being carried but not the damage.

tsunami.notes: Flat 8d6 (no scaling). Struck as the wave passes, so the hit is the wall's on_enter rather than the on-cast roll. No shape or size: the width is 10 feet per caster level and the map spec takes a fixed size, so the squares are not written.
